description: Carte Communale de la commune de BAGNEUX-LA-FOSSE is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wxs-gpu.mongeoportail.ign.fr. Map Communale (CC) digitised. This lot informs the right to build in the municipality of BAGNEUX-LA-FOSSE. This CC shall be digitised in accordance with the national requirements of the CNIG. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map Communale of the municipality of BAGNEUX-LA-FOSSE" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include planification, Carte communale, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2013-02-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
